name: B1 — 中级英语
description: 面向中文为母语的英语学习者:现在完成时、情态动词、条件句、被动语态、短语动词和假朋友词汇。重点突破中文里没有直接对应的英语结构。

topics.title: 现在完成时 (have/has + V3)
topics.description: 描述「从过去延续到现在」的动作 — 中文用「了/过」,英语必须用 have/has + 过去分词

guide.intro: 现在完成时是中文母语者最难掌握的英语时态。中文用「了」「过」表达「做完了」「经历过」,但「了」既能对应英语过去时,也能对应现在完成时,所以同学们经常误用过去时(I lived here for three years)。核心规则:动作开始于过去,直到现在仍有影响或仍在持续 → 必须用 have/has + V3。

sections.text: 肯定:主语 + have/has + V3(过去分词)。否定:主语 + haven't/hasn't + V3。疑问:Have/Has + 主语 + V3?
中文「我在北京住了三年」既可能指现在还住(present perfect),也可能指过去某段时间(past simple)。英语必须二选一。

rows.source: I have lived in Beijing for three years.
rows.translation: 我在北京住了三年(现在仍住在那里)。

rows.source: I lived in Beijing for three years.
rows.translation: 我在北京住过三年(现在不住了)。
她读过这本书(现在知道内容)。
她昨天读了这本书(过去某时间点)。

sections.text: 「yesterday」「last week」「in 2010」「when I was a child」这类「明确过去时间」不能与现在完成时连用。错误:「I have seen him yesterday.」正确:「I saw him yesterday.」

rows: + 起点 (2020, Monday, I was a child)

sections.text: 中文「自从」和「已经」都可以翻成 since 或 already,但 since 后面一定是「起点」,for 后面一定是「时长」。中文影响下常出错:「I have lived here since 5 years」是错的,应该是「for 5 years」。

rows.source: I have just finished my homework.
I haven't seen that film yet.
rows.translation: 我还没看过那部电影。(否定)

rows.source: Have you ever been to London?

sections.text: 中文母语者最常见的两个错误:1) 漏掉 have(「I been to Beijing」);2) 用过去时代替现在完成时(「I lived here for 3 years」表达「现在仍住」)。

lessons.title: 结构:have/has + V3
lessons.description: 现在完成时的基础结构

exercises.prompt: 「She ___ finished her work.」空格里应该填什么?
exercises.explanation: 第三人称单数 (she/he/it) 用「has」。中文里没有人称变化,这是中文母语者最常忽略的点。

exercises.prompt: 动词「go」的过去分词(V3)是什么?
exercises.explanation: go-went-gone。「went」是过去式,「gone」是过去分词,用在现在完成时里。
否定:have + not = haven't。中文用「没」一个字否定,英语必须 have + not + V3。
eat-ate-eaten。注意不是「eated」也不是「ate」。

exercises.prompt: 匹配动词原形和它的过去分词(V3)
「他们完成了那个项目(现在已结束)」

exercises.explanation: he/she/it + has + V3 (gone)。「has went」是中文母语者的高频错误 — 必须用 V3,不能用过去式。

exercises.spokenText: I have lost my keys.

exercises.explanation: 疑问句:Have/Has + 主语 + V3?中文「你去过……吗」用「吗」结尾,英语用 have 提前。

exercises.prompt: 动词「write」的过去分词形式是:
exercises.explanation: write-wrote-written。「wrote」是过去式(I wrote a letter),「written」是过去分词(I have written a letter)。

lessons.title: 现在完成时 vs 一般过去时
lessons.description: 什么时候用现在完成时,什么时候用一般过去时?

exercises.prompt: 「我在北京住了三年(现在仍住在那里)。」用英语怎么说?
options: I lived in Beijing for 3 years.
I am living in Beijing for 3 years.
I have lived in Beijing for 3 years.
I live in Beijing since 3 years.
exercises.answer: I have lived in Beijing for 3 years.
exercises.explanation: 「现在仍持续」→ 现在完成时。中文用「了」容易让人误选过去时。

exercises.prompt: 「我昨天看见他了。」用英语怎么说?
exercises.explanation: 「yesterday」是明确过去时间 → 一般过去时。现在完成时不能和明确过去时间词连用。

exercises.prompt: 哪一个时间表达不能和现在完成时连用?
exercises.explanation: 「yesterday」指向已结束的过去时间点。同类:last week, in 2010, when I was young。
since + 起点 → 现在完成时。
「last summer」是明确过去 → 一般过去时。

exercises.prompt: 把句子和它表达的时态意义匹配

pairs.right: 一般过去时 — 过去某时间点,现已结束

pairs.left: I have lived in Shanghai since 2010.
pairs.right: 现在完成时 — 现在仍在那里
一般过去时 — 去年,现在不在那儿了

pairs.left: I have worked here for a year.
pairs.right: 现在完成时 — 已持续一年

exercises.prompt: 「她从一月起就在这里工作(到现在仍在)」
exercises.answer: She has worked here since January

exercises.spokenText: We have known each other for ten years.
options: We have known each other for ten years.
We knew each other for ten years.
We have known each other since ten years.
We have know each other for ten years.
exercises.answer: We have known each other for ten years.

options: I have been here since Monday.
I have lived here for two years.
exercises.explanation: 「in 2015」是明确过去时间 → 必须用一般过去时:「I saw him in 2015.」

exercises.prompt: When I was a child, I ___ (love) ice cream.
exercises.explanation: 「when I was a child」是明确过去语境 → 一般过去时。

lessons.title: for / since 的区别
lessons.description: 时长用 for,起点用 since

exercises.explanation: 时长 (3 years) → for。
起点 (2020) → since。

exercises.prompt: I have known her ___ five years.
exercises.explanation: 时长 → for。
Monday 是起点 → since。

exercises.prompt: 「我学英语学了两年了(到现在还在学)」
exercises.answer: I have studied English for two years

options: I have lived here since 5 years.
I have lived here for 5 years.
I have lived here from 5 years.
I am living here since 5 years.
exercises.answer: I have lived here for 5 years.
exercises.explanation: 5 years 是时长 → for。「since 5 years」是中文母语者最常见的错误之一。

exercises.spokenText: She has been ill since Tuesday.
options: She has been ill since Tuesday.
She has been ill for Tuesday.
She has been ill from Tuesday.
exercises.answer: She has been ill since Tuesday.

exercises.prompt: We haven't seen each other ___ a long time.
「我从早上一直在工作。」用英语怎么说?
options: I have been working since morning.
exercises.answer: I have been working since morning.
exercises.explanation: 「一直在做」+「从早上(起点)」→ 现在完成进行时 + since。

lessons.title: just / already / yet / ever / never
lessons.description: 现在完成时常用副词的微妙差别

exercises.explanation: 「just」= 刚刚,极近的过去。
「yet」用于疑问句和否定句,放在句尾。
「never」本身就是否定意义,不需要再加 not。
「ever」= 曾经,用于疑问句。

exercises.prompt: 把副词和它的中文含义匹配

exercises.explanation: 「yet」只能用于疑问句或否定句,肯定句要用「already」。

exercises.spokenText: He has never seen the sea.
options: He has never seen the sea.
He has ever seen the sea.
He has never see the sea.
exercises.answer: He has never seen the sea.

exercises.prompt: 「你以前去过日本吗?」用英语怎么说?
options: Have you been to Japan ever?
Have you ever been to Japan?
Did you ever go to Japan before?
Have you ever go to Japan?
exercises.answer: Have you ever been to Japan?
exercises.explanation: 「ever」放在主语和 V3 之间。注意是 been,不是 go。

lessons.title: ever / never / yet / just / already 综合
lessons.description: 现在完成时副词的综合练习

exercises.prompt: 「我已经吃过午饭了。」用英语怎么说?
options: Both B and C are correct.
exercises.answer: Both B and C are correct.
exercises.explanation: 「already」可以放在 have 和 V3 之间,也可以放在句尾。但一定要用现在完成时,不能光用过去时。
「yet」用于否定句,放在句尾。注意是 hasn't + V3,不是过去时 didn't。

pairs.left: Have you ever woken up at 5 a.m.?

exercises.answer: He has never seen that film

exercises.explanation: 「ever」一般只用于疑问句,不用于陈述句。

exercises.spokenText: I haven't finished my homework yet.
options: I haven't finished my homework yet.
I have finished my homework yet.
I didn't finish my homework yet.
I haven't finish my homework yet.
exercises.answer: I haven't finished my homework yet.

exercises.prompt: 「你做过寿司吗?」用英语怎么说?
exercises.explanation: 问经历用现在完成时 + ever,V3 是 made。

exercises.prompt: 「我从来没听过这首歌。」哪句对?
options: I have never hear this song.
I never have heard this song.
I have never heard this song.
I haven't never heard this song.
exercises.answer: I have never heard this song.
exercises.explanation: never + V3 (heard)。never 本身是否定,不能再加 not。

lessons.title: 现在完成进行时(have/has been + V-ing)
lessons.description: 强调动作的持续与过程

exercises.prompt: 「我等了两个小时了。」用英语怎么说?
options: I am waiting for two hours.
I have waited for two hours.
I have been waiting for two hours.
exercises.answer: I have been waiting for two hours.
exercises.explanation: 「一直在做某事」+ 强调持续过程 → 现在完成进行时 (have been + V-ing)。
has been + V-ing。

exercises.prompt: 现在完成进行时的结构是:
exercises.explanation: have/has + been + 现在分词。

exercises.prompt: They ___ ___ ___ (work) on this project since June.
exercises.explanation: since + 起点 → 现在完成进行时强调持续。

pairs.left: 我跑了 5 公里(刚结束,有结果)
我跑了 1 小时了(还在跑)
pairs.right: I have been running for an hour.

pairs.left: 她一直在读书,还没读完
pairs.right: She has been reading the book.

exercises.answer: I have been studying English for three years

exercises.prompt: 哪一句更强调「持续了很久」的过程?
options: I have been reading for hours.
exercises.answer: I have been reading for hours.
exercises.explanation: 现在完成进行时强调「持续 + 过程」。

exercises.spokenText: It has been raining all day.
options: It has been raining all day.
It has been rain all day.
exercises.answer: It has been raining all day.

exercises.prompt: 哪个动词不能用现在完成进行时?
exercises.explanation: 状态动词(know、love、like、believe)一般不用进行时。要说「I have known her for years」,不是「I have been knowing」。
问「持续多久」用现在完成进行时。

exercises.prompt: 「我刚跑完步,所以满身大汗。」哪句对?
options: I have run, so I am sweaty.
I have been running, so I am sweaty.
I am running, so I am sweaty.
I ran, so I am sweaty.
exercises.answer: I have been running, so I am sweaty.
exercises.explanation: 强调最近持续的动作留下的痕迹 → 现在完成进行时。

exercises.prompt: 更合适的时态(完成时 vs 完成进行时)

pairs.left: 强调结果:她写完三封邮件了
强调过程:她一直在写邮件
强调过程:我一直在学 Python

lessons.title: 对话:多年后重逢
lessons.description: 在咖啡馆偶遇老朋友 — 自然语境中的现在完成时

exercises.prompt: 在咖啡馆偶遇老朋友 — 注意现在完成时的用法

turns.speaker: emma
turns.text: Oh my goodness, is that really you? I haven't seen you in ages!

turns.speaker: you
turns.text: Emma! Wow, you look exactly the same. How long has it been?

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: 选择正确的时态(我们已经多久没见面了 — 持续到现在)
options: We haven't met since university, I think.
We didn't meet since university, I think.
We don't meet since university, I think.
turns.answer: We haven't met since university, I think.

turns.speaker: emma
turns.text: That's almost six years! So tell me everything. What have you been up to?

turns.prompt: 填入正确的助动词(现在完成时)

topics.title: 情态动词(can、must、should、may、might)
topics.description: 表达能力、许可、义务和可能性

guide.intro: 情态动词在中文里对应「能、会、应该、必须、可能」等不同副词。中文母语者最常犯的错误是:1) 在情态动词后加 to(must to go);2) 用 must 表达「必须」而忽略 have to;3) 把「应该」全部翻成 should,忽视 ought to / had better 的微妙差别。

sections.text: 情态动词后必须跟动词原形,且不带 to。错误:He can to swim. 正确:He can swim. 例外:have to、ought to、had better(后面跟原形,但前两者带 to)。

rows: 能力(I can swim)、许可(Can I go?)
强烈义务(主观)、强烈推断

rows.translation: 我必须今晚完成(我自己觉得必须)。

rows.source: I have to wear a uniform at work.
rows.translation: 上班必须穿制服(规定要求)。

sections.text: mustn't 和 don't have to 完全不同!mustn't = 禁止(不能做);don't have to = 不必(可以不做)。

rows.translation: 你应该去看医生(一般建议)。
你应该道歉(比 should 更正式)。
你最好现在就走(不走会有麻烦)。

sections.text: 中文母语者高频错误:must to (×) → must (√);should to (×) → should (√)。情态动词后绝不能加 to(have to / ought to 除外)。

lessons.title: can / could — 能力与许可
lessons.description: 「会」「能」「可以」的英语对应

exercises.explanation: can + 动词原形。中文母语者常错加 to 或加 s。

exercises.prompt: 「我可以问个问题吗?」最礼貌的问法?
exercises.explanation: could 比 can 更礼貌、更委婉。may 也礼貌,但更正式。

exercises.prompt: When I was young, I ___ run very fast.
exercises.explanation: 「过去能够做某事」用 could。

options: He can to speak three languages.
exercises.answer: He can to speak three languages.
exercises.explanation: can 后面不加 to,直接接动词原形。这是中文母语者最高频的错误。

exercises.prompt: 把句子和它表达的含义匹配

pairs.left: I could ski when I was 10.
pairs.right: 我十岁时会滑雪。(过去能力)

exercises.spokenText: Could you open the window, please?
options: Could you open the window, please?
Can you open the window, please?
Could you to open the window, please?
You could open the window, please?
exercises.answer: Could you open the window, please?

exercises.explanation: Could / May 都很礼貌;Can 也可以,但稍微随便。

exercises.prompt: 「我小时候不会游泳。」用英语怎么说?
options: I cannot swim when I was a child.
I couldn't swim when I was a child.
I didn't can swim when I was a child.
I don't could swim when I was a child.
exercises.answer: I couldn't swim when I was a child.
exercises.explanation: 过去否定能力用 couldn't,不是 didn't can。

exercises.prompt: 「你能给我讲一下吗?」(礼貌请求)
exercises.explanation: Could you + 动词原形(无 to)。

lessons.title: must / have to — 义务
lessons.description: 主观必须 vs 客观规则

exercises.prompt: 「我必须今晚完成作业。」哪句对?
options: I must to finish my homework tonight.
I must finish my homework tonight.
I have finish my homework tonight.
I should to finish my homework tonight.
exercises.answer: I must finish my homework tonight.
exercises.explanation: must 后面直接跟动词原形,不加 to。这是中文母语者最常见的错误。

exercises.prompt: 「员工必须戴工作牌。」(客观规定)
options: Employees must to wear a badge.
Employees have to wear a badge.
exercises.answer: Employees have to wear a badge.
exercises.explanation: 外部规定一般用 have to。must 偏主观感受。

exercises.prompt: 下列哪项准确说明了「禁止」与「不必」这两个情态动词意义的区别?
options: mustn't = 禁止;don't have to = 不必
mustn't = 不必;don't have to = 禁止
exercises.answer: mustn't = 禁止;don't have to = 不必
exercises.explanation: 「You mustn't smoke」= 禁止抽烟(不能);「You don't have to come」= 你不必来(可以不来)。

exercises.prompt: 「你不必道歉(可以选择不道歉)。」哪句对?
exercises.explanation: 「不必」= don't have to;mustn't = 禁止。

exercises.prompt: You ___ ___ (wear) a helmet on this site.
exercises.explanation: 外部规定一般用 have to;主观也可用 must。
exercises.hint: 在这个工地你必须戴头盔。

exercises.prompt: 把英语句子和中文含义匹配

exercises.answer: I have to get up early

exercises.spokenText: You don't have to come if you're tired.
options: You don't have to come if you're tired.
You mustn't come if you're tired.
You don't must come if you're tired.
You haven't to come if you're tired.
exercises.answer: You don't have to come if you're tired.

exercises.explanation: must 没有过去式,过去「必须」用 had to。
学校规定可以用 have to 或 must。

lessons.title: should — 建议
lessons.description: 委婉的建议、轻微的义务

exercises.explanation: should + 动词原形,不加 to。
should + 原形 see,不要写成 to see 或 saw。

options: You shouldn't to stay up late.
You don't should stay up late.
You should not to stay up late.
exercises.explanation: shouldn't + 原形。注意没有 do/does 助动词。
疑问句:Should + 主语 + 原形?

exercises.prompt: She doesn't feel well. She ___ rest.
exercises.explanation: should 是建议。
exercises.hint: 她身体不舒服，应该休息一下。

exercises.spokenText: You shouldn't worry too much.
options: You don't should worry too much.
You shouldn't to worry too much.

exercises.prompt: 下列三个情态动词中,哪一个语气最弱、最偏向「建议」?
exercises.explanation: should = 建议;must / have to = 必须。

exercises.prompt: I think you ___ apologise to her.
exercises.explanation: 建议用 should。
exercises.hint: 我觉得你应该向她道歉。

lessons.title: may / might — 可能性
lessons.description: 「也许」的两个英语对应

options: He may to be at home.
exercises.explanation: may + 动词原形(be)。注意 may be 是两个词,maybe 是副词。

exercises.prompt: 在表达「不太确定」的可能性时,哪个情态动词的可能性更小?
exercises.explanation: might 表达的可能性比 may 稍小,也更不确定。
might + 原形,主语第三人称也不变形。

exercises.prompt: She ___ ___ (come) later, but I'm not sure.
exercises.explanation: 不确定的可能性 → might / may + 原形。
exercises.hint: 她可能晚点来，不过我不确定。

exercises.prompt: 把英文情态动词和中文匹配

pairs.right: 可能(中等可能性,较正式)
可能(较低可能性,不太确定)

exercises.spokenText: She might not come to the party.
options: She might not come to the party.
She may not come to the party.
She might not comes to the party.
She doesn't might come to the party.
exercises.answer: She might not come to the party.

exercises.explanation: must 用于强烈推断:「一定是」。

exercises.prompt: She left an hour ago. She ___ be at the airport by now.
exercises.explanation: must 表示「肯定、一定」。
exercises.hint: 她一小时前就走了，现在一定到机场了。

exercises.prompt: 「他不可能在那儿,他在中国。」哪句对?
options: He mustn't be there. He's in China.
He can't be there. He's in China.
He may not be there. He's in China.
He shouldn't be there. He's in China.
exercises.answer: He can't be there. He's in China.
exercises.explanation: 推断否定用 can't(= 不可能);mustn't = 禁止。

lessons.title: must / have to / mustn't / don't have to
lessons.description: 义务与禁止的细致区别

topics.title: 条件句(if 从句)
topics.description: 零型、第一型和第二型条件句 — 真实 vs 假设

guide.intro: 中文「如果……就……」结构统一,但英语条件句根据「真实性」分成几型,动词形式各不相同。中文母语者最常见的错误是把第一型和第二型混在一起(例如「If I have time tomorrow, I would go」)。

rows.source: If you heat water to 100°C, it boils.
If I'm tired, I drink coffee.
If it rains tomorrow, we will stay home.
rows.translation: 如果明天下雨,我们就待在家。

rows.source: If I have time tonight, I'll call you.
rows.translation: 我今晚有空就给你打电话。

sections.text: 1 型条件句:if 从句里不能用 will!错误:「If it will rain」;正确:「If it rains」。

rows.source: If I had a million dollars, I would buy a house.
rows.translation: 如果我有一百万美元,我就会买房子(实际上没有)。

rows.source: If I were you, I would apologise.
rows.translation: 如果我是你,我会道歉(我不是你)。

sections.text: 2 型条件句惯用「If I were」(不是 was),即使主语是 I/he/she。这是从虚拟语气延续下来的固定用法。

items: if + will:「If it will rain」(× → If it rains)
类型混搭:「If I have time, I would go」(× → If I have time, I will go)
省略助动词:「If I am you」(× → If I were you)
用现在时表假设:「If I am rich」(× 真实 / If I were rich = 假设)

lessons.title: 零型条件句 — 一般真理
lessons.description: 科学规律和习惯性事实

exercises.prompt: 「水加热到 100°C 就沸腾。」哪句对?
options: If you heat water to 100°C, it will boil.
If you heat water to 100°C, it boils.
If you will heat water to 100°C, it boils.
If you heated water to 100°C, it would boil.
exercises.answer: If you heat water to 100°C, it boils.
exercises.explanation: 0 型条件句:if + 现在时 + 现在时,表达一般真理。
0 型:if + 现在时 + 现在时。
exercises.hint: 如果我累了，我就喝咖啡。

exercises.prompt: 哪一句是 0 型条件句(一般真理)?
options: If it rains, the grass gets wet.
If it rains tomorrow, we'll stay home.
If I had time, I would help.
If she comes, please tell me.
exercises.answer: If it rains, the grass gets wet.
exercises.explanation: 0 型 = 自然/习惯性结果。

exercises.prompt: If you ___ (mix) red and blue, you ___ (get) purple.
exercises.hint: 如果你把红色和蓝色混合，就会得到紫色。

exercises.prompt: 把 if 从句和合适的主句匹配(0 型)

exercises.answer: If I am tired I drink coffee

exercises.spokenText: If it snows, the roads get slippery.
options: If it snows, the roads get slippery.
If it will snow, the roads get slippery.
If it snowed, the roads would get slippery.
If it snows, the roads will get slippery.
exercises.answer: If it snows, the roads get slippery.

exercises.prompt: 0 型条件句最大的特点是?
options: if 从句和主句都用现在时
if 从句用现在时,主句用 will
if 从句用过去时,主句用 would
if 从句用 will,主句用现在时
exercises.answer: if 从句和主句都用现在时
exercises.explanation: 0 型 = 两边都是现在时。

exercises.hint: 如果天气晴朗，孩子们就在外面玩。

options: If you don't sleep, you get tired.
If you don't sleep, you will get tired.
If you don't sleep, you would get tired.
If you didn't sleep, you would get tired.
exercises.answer: If you don't sleep, you would get tired.
exercises.explanation: if + 现在时 + would 是类型混搭。要么用 will(1 型),要么 if 从句用过去时(2 型)。

lessons.title: 第一型条件句 — 将来可能
lessons.description: 可能发生的将来

exercises.prompt: 「如果明天下雨,我们就待在家。」哪句对?
options: If it will rain tomorrow, we stay home.
If it rains tomorrow, we will stay home.
If it rained tomorrow, we would stay home.
If it rains tomorrow, we would stay home.
exercises.answer: If it rains tomorrow, we will stay home.
exercises.explanation: 1 型:if + 现在时,主句 will + 原形。

exercises.prompt: If I ___ (have) time tomorrow, I ___ (call) you.
exercises.explanation: 1 型:if + 现在时,主句 will + 原形。
exercises.hint: 如果我明天有时间，我就给你打电话。

options: If you study hard, you will pass.
If you will study hard, you will pass.
If she comes, I will be happy.
If it rains, the picnic will be cancelled.
exercises.answer: If you will study hard, you will pass.
exercises.explanation: 1 型条件句:if 从句里不能用 will!这是中文母语者高频错误。

exercises.prompt: If you ___ (eat) too much, you ___ (feel) sick later.
exercises.hint: 如果你吃得太多，过会儿会不舒服。

exercises.prompt: 把 if 从句和合适的主句匹配(1 型)

exercises.answer: If I am free I will come

exercises.spokenText: If you are late again, I will be very upset.
options: If you are late again, I will be very upset.
If you will be late again, I will be very upset.
If you were late again, I would be very upset.
If you are late again, I would be very upset.
exercises.answer: If you are late again, I will be very upset.

exercises.prompt: 1 型条件句的结构是什么?
options: if + 过去时, would + 原形
if + 现在时, will + 原形
if + 现在时, 现在时
exercises.answer: if + 现在时, will + 原形

exercises.prompt: If she ___ (call), I ___ (tell) her the news.
exercises.hint: 如果她打来电话，我会告诉她这个消息。

options: If it will be sunny, we go to the beach.
If it is sunny, we will go to the beach.
If it is sunny, we would go to the beach.
If it was sunny, we will go to the beach.
exercises.answer: If it is sunny, we will go to the beach.
exercises.explanation: 将来可能 + 将来计划 → 1 型。

lessons.title: 第二型条件句 — 假设现在
lessons.description: 与现实相反的假设

exercises.prompt: 「如果我是百万富翁,我就会买一栋房子(我不是)。」
options: If I am a millionaire, I will buy a house.
If I were a millionaire, I would buy a house.
If I will be a millionaire, I would buy a house.
If I were a millionaire, I will buy a house.
exercises.answer: If I were a millionaire, I would buy a house.
exercises.explanation: 2 型:if + 过去时(were), 主句 would + 原形 = 与现实相反的假设。
「If I were you」是固定表达(虚拟语气),很标准。
exercises.hint: 如果我是你，我就会道歉。

exercises.prompt: 哪一句表达「与现实相反」?
options: If I have time, I'll help you.
If I had time, I would help you.
If I'm tired, I drink coffee.
If it rains, we stay home.
exercises.answer: If I had time, I would help you.
exercises.explanation: had + would = 2 型 = 现在不可能/不真实。

exercises.prompt: If she ___ (know) the truth, she ___ (be) angry.
exercises.hint: 如果她知道真相，她会很生气。

exercises.prompt: 把 if 从句和合适的主句匹配(2 型)

pairs.right: we would speak French every day.

exercises.answer: If I had money I would buy it

exercises.spokenText: If I were you, I would take the job.
options: If I were you, I would take the job.
If I am you, I will take the job.
If I were you, I will take the job.
If I was you, I would taking the job.
exercises.answer: If I were you, I would take the job.

options: if + 现在时, will + 原形
if + 过去时, would + 原形
if + 过去时, will + 原形
if + 过去完成时, would have + V3
exercises.answer: if + 过去时, would + 原形

exercises.prompt: If I ___ (win) the lottery, I ___ (travel) around the world.
exercises.hint: 如果我中了彩票，我就要环游世界。

exercises.prompt: 「如果我是鸟,我就会飞。」哪句最自然?
options: If I am a bird, I can fly.
If I were a bird, I would fly.
If I will be a bird, I would fly.
If I was a bird, I will fly.
exercises.answer: If I were a bird, I would fly.
exercises.explanation: 不可能/假设 → 2 型,if + were + would。

lessons.title: 三种条件句综合练习
lessons.description: 选择正确的类型

exercises.prompt: 「如果明天有时间,我会给你打电话。」(将来 — 可能)
options: If I had time tomorrow, I would call you.
If I have time tomorrow, I will call you.
If I will have time tomorrow, I call you.
If I have time tomorrow, I would call you.
exercises.answer: If I have time tomorrow, I will call you.
exercises.explanation: 将来可能 = 1 型。中文母语者常错把 1 型和 2 型混搭(if 现在 + would)。

exercises.prompt: 「如果我有时间(实际没有),我会帮你。」(假设)
options: If I have time, I would help you.
If I had time, I would help you.
If I had time, I will help you.
If I will have time, I would help you.
exercises.answer: If I had time, I would help you.
exercises.explanation: 与现实相反 = 2 型,if + had + would。

exercises.prompt: 「植物缺水就会枯死。」(一般真理)
options: If plants don't get water, they die.
If plants will not get water, they die.
If plants didn't get water, they would die.
If plants don't get water, they will die.
exercises.answer: If plants don't get water, they die.
exercises.explanation: 0 型 = 自然规律。两边都用现在时。

exercises.prompt: If I ___ (be) rich, I ___ (help) the poor.
exercises.hint: 如果我有钱，我就会帮助穷人。

exercises.prompt: If you ___ (study), you ___ (pass) the exam next week.
exercises.hint: 如果你学习，下周考试你就能通过。

exercises.prompt: 把句子和它的类型匹配

pairs.left: If you heat ice, it melts.
If it rains, we will stay home.
If I were rich, I would travel.
If I have time, I'll call.

exercises.prompt: 「如果我是你,我就道歉(我不是你)」
exercises.answer: If I were you I would apologise

exercises.spokenText: If I had a map, I wouldn't be lost now.
options: If I had a map, I wouldn't be lost now.
If I have a map, I won't be lost now.
If I had a map, I won't be lost now.
If I will have a map, I wouldn't be lost.
exercises.answer: If I had a map, I wouldn't be lost now.

options: If it rains, we will stay home.
If I had money, I would buy it.
If I have time, I would help.
If you heat water, it boils.
exercises.answer: If I have time, I would help.
exercises.explanation: if + 现在时 + would = 类型混搭(中文母语者最高频的错误)。应该是 will help 或者 if I had time, I would help。

exercises.prompt: 「如果我中了彩票(假设),我会环游世界。」
options: If I win the lottery, I would travel the world.
If I won the lottery, I would travel the world.
If I had won the lottery, I would travel.
If I won the lottery, I will travel the world.
exercises.answer: If I won the lottery, I would travel the world.
exercises.explanation: 2 型 — 假设(不太可能):if + 过去时 + would + 原形。

lessons.title: 混合条件句和第三型条件句
lessons.description: 过去对现在 / 过去对过去

exercises.prompt: 「如果当初我学得更努力一点,现在就会有更好的工作。」(过去 → 现在)
options: If I studied harder, I would have a better job now.
If I had studied harder, I would have a better job now.
If I had studied harder, I will have a better job now.
If I studied harder, I had a better job now.
exercises.answer: If I had studied harder, I would have a better job now.
exercises.explanation: 混合型:if + had + V3 (过去) + would + 原形 (现在结果)。

exercises.prompt: 「如果当时我看到他,我就会跟他打招呼。」(过去对过去 — 3 型)
options: If I saw him, I would say hello.
If I had seen him, I would have said hello.
If I had seen him, I would say hello.
If I saw him, I would have said hello.
exercises.answer: If I had seen him, I would have said hello.
exercises.explanation: 3 型:if + had + V3 + would have + V3。过去事实的相反假设。

exercises.hint: 如果我早点知道，我就帮你了。

exercises.prompt: If she ___ ___ ___ (take) the bus, she ___ ___ ___ ___ (be) here by now.
exercises.hint: 如果她坐了公交车，她现在应该已经到了。

pairs.left: If I had studied, I would have passed.
If I had studied, I would have a good job now.
If I studied, I would pass.
If I study, I will pass.

options: if + 过去时, would + 原形
if + 过去完成时, would have + V3
if + 现在时, will + 原形
if + 过去完成时, will + 原形
exercises.answer: if + 过去完成时, would have + V3
exercises.explanation: 3 型用于过去与事实相反的假设。

If they will come earlier, they catch the flight.
If they come earlier, they will catch the flight.
exercises.answer: If they had come earlier, they would have caught the flight.

exercises.prompt: If I ___ ___ ___ (sleep) more, I ___ ___ ___ ___ (feel) better today.
exercises.hint: 如果我多睡一会儿，今天就会感觉好一些。

options: If I were rich, I would buy a house.
If I had been rich, I would have bought a house.
If I had been rich, I will buy a house.
If I had been rich, I would buy a house now.
exercises.answer: If I had been rich, I will buy a house.
exercises.explanation: 中文「如果」不区分真实/虚拟条件。英语中 if + had + V3 (虚拟过去) 必须配 would/could/might，不能配 will (那是真实将来条件)。

exercises.prompt: 把句子配对到对应的含义:

pairs.left: If I were taller, I'd be a model.
pairs.right: 现在事实相反 (现在我个子矮)

pairs.right: 过去事实相反 (过去没学习)

lessons.title: wish / if only / unless
lessons.description: 愿望、遗憾和例外

exercises.answer: I wish I hadn't said that.

exercises.spokenText: I wish I could fly.

topics.title: 被动语态(Passive Voice)
topics.description: 用 be + V3 构成的被动句

guide.intro: 中文「被」字句的使用范围比英语 passive 窄得多,而且不一定要明示。英语在很多场合(科学描述、新闻、客观说明)必须用被动语态,但中文常用主动语态。中文母语者最常见的错误是:1) 漏掉 be(「the book wrote by him」);2) 用动词原形或过去式代替 V3(「was eat」)。

sections.text: 被动语态 = 主语 + be + V3(过去分词)+ (by + 施动者)。be 的形式根据时态变化。

sections.text: 短语动词 = 动词 + 小品词(up, down, in, on, off, out 等),整体意思往往无法从字面推出。

lessons.description: 当宾语是代词时会发生什么?

exercises.prompt: 可分离短语动词（如 turn off）后面的宾语是代词（it / him / them）时，代词放在哪里？
options: 必须放在动词和小品词之间
exercises.answer: 必须放在动词和小品词之间
exercises.explanation: 可分离短语动词 + 代词宾语 → 必须分开：Turn it off. (√)  Turn off it. (×) 名词宾语两种都可以：Turn off the light / Turn the light off. 但代词宾语只能放中间。
代词宾语必须放在动词和小品词之间：Turn it off / Turn them off。Turn off it 是中文学习者根据语序直译造成的典型错误。
代词宾语（them）放在 pick 和 up 之间。pick the kids up 和 pick up the kids 都对，但 pick up them 是错的。
look after = 照顾（不可分离短语动词）。代词宾语也只能放在 after 之后：look after them (√)  look them after (×)。和可分离的 turn off / pick up 不同。
turn off 可分离；代词 it 必须放在中间。Please turn off it（×）。中文「把它关掉」中的「它」对应代词 it，提示要分离。
代词宾语（him）必须放在 pick 和 up 之间。名词宾语（John）两种语序都对。看到代词，要立刻想到「分离」。

exercises.prompt: 「检查一下你的答案。」用英语怎么说？
exercises.explanation: 中文「检查」对应英语 check，不是 control。control = 控制（操控权力/系统）。「检查答案、检查邮件、检查行李」一律 check。这是中文学习者最常犯的伪同源词错误。
